name: motif_count
author: eaf1d77a
description: Counts small recurring patterns (motifs) in a graph. For every graph: triangles, wedges (2-paths), open wedges (missing triangles), 3-stars, 4-cycles, the transitivity (share of wedges that close into triangles) and the top_k nodes that sit in the most triangles. For directed graphs it also returns the full 16-type triad census and the classic directed motifs: feed-forward loops (a->b, b->c, a->c) and 3-cycles (a->b->c->a). Use for questions like 'Which small patterns are most common?', 'How many triangles are there?', 'How many feed-forward loops does this network have?' or 'How many triangles is Alice part of?' (pass node). Returns counts, the triad census for directed graphs, and nodes with id and label.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse

node.description: Optional node ID: also report how many triangles this node is part of

top_k.description: How many nodes to list in top_triangle_nodes
